headline: A 2022 federal law renames the Slatersville, Rhode Island post office at 42 Main Street after Specialist Matthew R. Turcotte.
what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service facility a new name. The building at 42 Main Street in Slatersville, Rhode Island, is now called the Specialist Matthew R. Turcotte Post Office. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or who runs it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on February 22, 2022, and the designation took effect that day.
